title: Mortgage War Room — Loan Exception Command
tagline: Catch the underwriting exception before it becomes a stalled closing.
painPoint: Loan exceptions get discovered late — usually right before a closing date that now has to move.

steps.caption: The Mortgage War Room
steps.talk: This is where loan exceptions land the moment they're flagged — not three days before closing.

steps.caption: Loading a live loan file
steps.talk: We're loading a real loan file with an active exception — the kind that usually surfaces in a frantic closing-day phone call.

steps.caption: AI analysis, one click
steps.talk: One click and the AI analyzes the exception — compliance risk, investor guideline conflict, and a recommended resolution path.

steps.caption: Relay to strategist
steps.talk: One click relays this to the strategist — no re-keying loan data.

steps.caption: Strategist workspace
steps.talk: The strategist view synthesizes the exception into a resolution recommendation.

steps.caption: AI summary
steps.talk: This is the summary a processing manager would normally have to build by hand from three different systems.

steps.caption: Executive escalation
steps.talk: One click, straight to the executive portal — zero re-entry.

steps.caption: Pipeline risk, live
steps.talk: Total pipeline-at-risk, live — the number that actually determines whether this month's closings hit target.

cta: TSM catches the exception the day it's created — not the day before the closing that has to move.
